title: Terracotta Arch & Bohemian Botanical Sun Tough Phone Case | Minimalist Boho Dual-Layer Cover
description:
Protect your phone in premium artisan style with the Terracotta Arch & Bohemian Botanical Sun Tough Phone Case.

Designed for the Minimalist Boho collection, this case combines high-impact shock absorption with edge-to-edge full-bleed artwork that will not fade, scratch, or peel.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:
- Dual-layer protection: Impact-resistant Polycarbonate outer shell + Shock-absorbing TPU silicone liner
- Full-bleed 300 DPI sublimation printing with rich saturated pigments
- Engineered camera bezel with 35% upper safe zone protection
- Wireless charging (Qi & MagSafe compatible)
- Available for Apple iPhone & Samsung Galaxy flagship models

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
Wipe clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Mild soap may be used if needed.
prompt: Full-bleed 9:16 vertical phone case artwork. Minimalist bohemian art print. Textured terracotta sun rising over mid-century arched gateway. Organic monstera leaves and dried pampas grass in lower canvas. Clean modern lines, warm earthy neutral palette, zero device mockups.
